description: An older man in a flat cap and a waxed green jacket stands in a line of people at a city bus stop. The pavement is dark and shining with water, puddles have collected along the kerb, and everyone in the queue is holding a black umbrella up over their head. The camera moves under his umbrella and you can see the drops running off its edge and beading on the stretched fabric while a red double-decker bus passes on the wet road behind. The clip then cuts to the same man indoors in a warm pub, stirring a cup of tea and dunking a biscuit into it.

en.question: What is the old man doing?

de.answer: Er gibt Milch in seinen Tee.

es.answer: Está echando leche a su té.

fr.answer: Il met du lait dans son thé.
